annotation.emotional_arc: longing and sorrow to quiet peace

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: A pervasive feeling of melancholy or sadness that fills the autumn evening.
acceptable_visual_variants: A quiet, empty park bench under a bare tree at dusk
A misty path covered in fallen leaves with soft, dim lighting
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: A musical melody composed of sadness
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal musical notes floating in the air, which would look whimsical rather than melancholic.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a desolate autumn landscape with falling leaves and a solitary, quiet atmosphere that evokes a somber mood visually.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The quiet, lingering sadness of the evening feels like a distant, forgotten memory or voice.
acceptable_visual_variants: A vast, empty field under a twilight sky
A single leaf suspended mid-air in a quiet forest
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Like a voice that has been lost
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting a literal disembodied mouth or sound waves, which would look surreal or ghostly.
metaphor_spans.tenor: The quiet, lingering sadness of the autumn evening
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Focus on the visual representation of silence and emptiness, such as a vast, empty landscape fading into twilight.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'सूखे पत्तों' (dry leaves) as 'fallen leaves', losing the specific sensory texture of dryness which emphasizes the crackling silence.
The Hindi verb 'बसी है' carries a sense of being settled, inhabited, or deeply infused, which is slightly flattened by the English 'lingers'.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The slow, gentle descent of each leaf evokes a sense of carrying and preserving a long-held sorrow.
acceptable_visual_variants: A close-up of a single brown leaf drifting slowly against a soft-focus background
A leaf resting gently on still, dark water
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: As if it is carefully holding or managing an old grief
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting a leaf with human hands holding a physical object labeled 'grief' or looking cartoonishly sad.
metaphor_spans.source_span_original: जैसे कोई पुराना ग़म संभाल रहा हो
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: As if holding an old sorrow
metaphor_spans.source_term: जैसे कोई पुराना ग़म संभाल रहा हो
metaphor_spans.tenor: The slow, gentle falling motion of an autumn leaf
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A person carefully carrying or holding onto a long-held grief
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Capture the slow, drifting motion of a single leaf falling through the air in close-up, emphasizing its fragile and solitary descent.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The cool evening air carries a strong, haunting sense of nostalgia and past memories.
acceptable_visual_variants: Long, dramatic shadows of bare branches stretching across the ground at sunset
A misty, dim forest path where light barely filters through
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: As if the shadow of past time is dwelling there
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing literal ghostly figures or clock faces in the shadows, which would look too supernatural.
metaphor_spans.source_span_original: जैसे बीते वक्त की परछाई बसी हो
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: Dwells the shadow of time gone by
metaphor_spans.source_term: जैसे बीते वक्त की परछाई बसी हो
metaphor_spans.tenor: The nostalgic and haunting atmosphere of the cool evening air
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A shadow cast by the past
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Use long, deep shadows cast by bare trees in the late afternoon sun to visually suggest the 'shadow of time'.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The Urdu-derived word 'ग़म' (grief/sorrow) carries a deep, poetic weight of existential or romantic melancholy in Hindustani poetry that is rendered as a simpler 'sorrow' in English.
The grammatical gender agreement in 'बसी हो' (feminine, agreeing with 'परछाई' / shadow) is lost in the gender-neutral English verb 'dwells'.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: The evening becomes completely quiet and still, as if wrapped in a protective, calming blanket.
acceptable_visual_variants: A soft blue twilight mist settling over a quiet valley
A dark, peaceful sky blanketed with the first faint stars of evening
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Wearing a sheet or blanket of peace
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing a literal blanket or piece of fabric draped over the landscape or sky, which would look absurd.
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation: draped in a cloak of peace
metaphor_spans.tenor: The quiet, enveloping stillness of the deepening evening
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a soft, uniform layer of twilight mist or the deep blue dusk settling evenly over the landscape to represent the enveloping peace.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation renders 'चादर' (sheet/shroud) as 'cloak', which changes the domestic and comforting metaphor of a covering sheet or blanket to a more formal garment.

annotation.theme: The quiet, reflective melancholy of an autumn evening that transitions into a peaceful, deep silence.

original_poem:
पतझड़ में पड़ने वाली शाम,  
सूखे पत्तों की खामोशी में,  
बसी है एक उदासी की धुन,  
जैसे खोई हुई कोई आवाज़।

हर पत्ता गिरता है आहिस्ता,  
जैसे कोई पुराना ग़म संभाल रहा हो।  
उस शाम की ठंडी हवा में,  
जैसे बीते वक्त की परछाई बसी हो।

सूरज की आखिरी किरणें,  
पेड़ों के पीछे छिप जाती हैं,  
और शांति की चादर ओढ़े,  
वह शाम गहरी हो जाती है।
translated_poem:
An evening in autumn,  
In the silence of fallen leaves,  
Lingers a melody of sorrow,  
Like a lost voice.

Each leaf falls slowly,  
As if holding an old sorrow.  
In the cool air of that evening,  
Dwells the shadow of time gone by.

The last rays of the sun,  
Hide behind the trees,  
And draped in a cloak of peace,  
That evening deepens.
